data.name: Nazhiif
data.gender_notes: Nazhiif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root n-z-h, meaning 'to help' or 'to aid'. Nazhiif is a name for a boy who is strong in faith and helps those around him. The name Nazhiif carries the meaning “Helpful, strong in faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazhiif usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, strong in faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spirit of helping others and staying steadfast in faith.
data.etymology: Nazhiif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helpful, strong in faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazhiif total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
